title: Apple Explores Using Light to Move Data Between Server Chips
excerpt: Apple is hiring an engineering program manager to work on light-based data connections for its server chips, in what could be a sign of the...
content_html:
Monday November 23, 2026 4:29 am PST by Tim Hardwick

Apple is hiring an engineering program manager to work on light-based data connections for its server chips, in what could be a sign of the company's broader ambitions in data-center infrastructure.


The Silicon Photonics EPM listing was highlighted by Korea's Maeil Business, and seeks experience with optical I/O, silicon photonics and co-packaged optics, with responsibilities spanning concept through mass production.

The optical interconnects are considered to be an emerging core technology for AI data centers, and use light to move data between chips rather than to perform computations. The listing follows a September report that Apple was exploring a return to the server market using its own M-series chips amid cost and speed challenges. Apple discontinued Xserve in 2011.
